subject.title: [OAuth] Client ID revoked `app_EMoamEEZ73f0CkXaXp7hrann` - fresh ChatGPT Plus logins completely broken

question: Should OpenClaw rotate or override the bundled ChatGPT/Codex OAuth client ID now, or wait for upstream OpenAI/Codex confirmation?
rationale: The code change is small, but the durable fix depends on OAuth app ownership, live account proof, and compatibility with upstream Codex browser, device-code, and refresh behavior.

options.title: Verify and coordinate rotation
options.body: Confirm the fresh-account browser failure, obtain or approve the replacement OAuth client, and update both browser and device-code paths with focused tests and docs.

options.title: Defer to upstream default
options.body: Keep the current client ID while upstream Codex still ships it, and leave this issue open until a confirmed upstream replacement or revocation notice exists.

options.title: Add a temporary override
options.body: Introduce an explicit maintainer-owned override path only if maintainers accept the new config surface and upgrade burden.

recommendation.title: Verify and coordinate rotation
recommendation.body: Confirm the fresh-account browser failure, obtain or approve the replacement OAuth client, and update both browser and device-code paths with focused tests and docs.
